cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Be Right in Retrospect
cards.instruction: Perform certainty by reinterpreting every surprise as something your earlier words were obviously predicting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. When I said the evening would flow, I meant this kitchen flood.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Water is now the dominant topic. A remarkably accurate forecast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You didn't predict a burst pipe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I said we'd need to open up. The plumbing listened first.
